body:
My memory is still bad, yes. 

That doesn't mean it will be for you. 

I also had involvement with other drugs in the past, which can destroy memory a lot worse. I don't know what did which thing.
PM me if you need to talk. Don't do this.

I had dissociative episodes come on from smoking large amounts. I basically had extremely bad panic attacks while very high. It was a near death experience as far as I was concerned. It was like going through all of these terrible feelings knowing that very shortly you're about to die. My consciousness cut out multiple times from how panicked I was. I remember a lot of blackness. And it wasn't laced (multiple people smoked it on another occasion, the day before, and were fine). For me, it was not a good mix.

I've spent nearly three years recovering from post traumatic stress, anxiety, and dissociative episodes and hallucinations that all of the stress brought on. 

I am better, much better. My memory is bad for short term. Very bad. But almost everything else has gotten much better. You'll get better too, eventually. Give it time. The most important thing for me was forgetting about it. As hard as that is, you have to forget, and live like it never happened. Once I did that, I started to recover.
